rows.grounds: genitive plural indicating those to be expelled
genitive plural indicating those to be received
dative of purpose expressing acceptance or protection

items.question: What dual purpose of expelling the wicked and receiving the good is affirmed?
items.inference: The affirmed function simultaneously removes harmful agents and embraces virtuous ones.
uncertainties: Whether grahaṇāya implies protection, acceptance, or both in this context.
items.plain_english: You are for driving away the wicked and for receiving the good.
